old_title: Kangaroos halfback's World Cup ends with calf muscle injury
new_title: World Cup heartbreak for Kangaroos half as Tonga notches first win over England
old_text:
Fri, 18 Sept, 7:50 pm, Final score, Tigers 0, Raiders 6
Mitchell Moses calf injury ends Rugby League World Cup for Kangaroos halfback as PNG begins tournament with wins
In short:
Mitchell Moses will miss the remainder of the Rugby League World Cup after being ruled out of the Kangaroos' title defence with a lower leg injury.
The Parramatta playmaker suffered the injury during Australia's tournament opener on Thursday night.
Meanwhile, Papua New Guinea's men's and women's sides began their tournaments with victories, and England eased to a 70-6 win over Wales in the women's competition.
new_text:
Fri, 18 Sept, 7:50 pm, Final score, Tigers 0, Raiders 6
Mitchell Moses' calf injury ends Rugby League World Cup for Kangaroos halfback as Tonga defeats England
In short:
Mitchell Moses will miss the remainder of the Rugby League World Cup after being ruled out of the Kangaroos' title defence with a lower leg injury.
Meanwhile, England's hopes of reaching the semi-finals are already on life support after suffering a 30-12 loss to Tonga in Perth.
Papua New Guinea's men's and women's sides began their tournaments with victories, while England breezed past Wales in the women's competition.
